author: Okkerka
install_msg: Experimental baseline: install required dependencies with `[p]pipinstall tidalapi spotipy google-api-python-client rapidfuzz`, then run `[p]tidalsetup login` for Tidal, `[p]tidalsetup spotify` followed by `[p]tidalsetup spotifylogin` for Spotify imports, and `[p]tidalsetup youtube` for YouTube metadata and playlists. This baseline will become native in a later migration.
name: TidalPlayerExp
short: Experimental Tidal playback baseline; native playback migration comes later.
description: Experimental Tidal music integration baseline for Red-DiscordBot. Preserves the existing Lavalink/Audio behavior, album art, Spotify and YouTube imports, fallback matching, playlists, and now-playing embeds while preparing for a later native playback migration. Do not load this alongside TidalPlayer because public command names overlap.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Tidal and Spotify OAuth credentials globally for the bot owner. It does not store data associated with individual Discord users.
